title: taraxacum norvegicum
intro: Taraxacum norvegicum, commonly known as the Norwegian dandelion, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the sunflower family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including the ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and support liver function. The therapeutic actions of Taraxacum norvegicum include its diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as urinary tract infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include taraxasterol, taraxerol, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
